title: All-Optical Nonlinear Diffractive Deep Network for Ultrafast Image Denoising

layout.note: Two heavy-bordered frames side by side, a wide red one holding the 3D render and two small measurement boxes, a narrow purple one holding the agent; three green arrows cross between them and one runs round the bottom.

lesson: Frame a learned optimiser and the system it tunes as agent and environment: one heavy-bordered region for the system, one for the learner, three colour-matched arrows for state, reward and action, and the action arrow routed round the bottom to close the loop.
